name: Asana
description: This plugin is used to create tasks on Asana platform. It also supports updating tasks, syncing their status and severity.

fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Base URL of the Asana REST API. Default: https://app.asana.com/api/1.0.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Asana Personal Access Token. The token can be created from the [Asana Developer Console](https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps) > Personal access tokens > Create new token.
